Observed:
- Watery diarrhea (20 episodes per day)
- Vomiting and diffuse abdominal pain
- Brownish macules on the hands and feet
- Hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
- Onychodystrophy
- 4-week history of symptoms
- 8-kg weight loss (≈15% of body weight)
- Mild hypoproteinemia and hypoalbuminemia
- Zinc deficiency
- Low vitamin B12
- Multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
- Nodular lymphoid lesions in the duodenum
- Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
- History of cleft lip and palate repair
- Recurrent diarrheal episodes since childhood
Differential diagnosis:
1. Juvenile polyposis syndrome
2. Crohn's disease
3. Celiac disease
4. Autoimmune enteropathy
5. Abetalipoproteinemia
